name: Ultimate ASI Loader
description: Loads ASI plugins when the game starts. The basis for trainers and most mods. Installs dinput8.dll.

sources.note: x86 build without debug symbols. GTA IV is 32-bit; the x64 variant would be wrong. If the download fails: https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader/releases, tag v9.7.4, file Ultimate-ASI-Loader-NoPDB.zip - another version has another checksum and would be refused.
